keyboardHelp.tools: Tools: V select, R rectangle, D diamond, O ellipse, A arrow, L line, P draw, T text, E eraser, K laser pointer, H hand.
keyboardHelp.draw: Enter draws the tool's shape, Q keeps the tool.
keyboardHelp.navigate: Tab and Shift+Tab move through the elements, Ctrl+A selects all, Escape deselects.
keyboardHelp.edit: Arrow keys move the selection, with Shift further. Delete removes, Ctrl+D duplicates, Ctrl+G groups and Ctrl+Shift+G ungroups, Ctrl+Shift+L locks, Ctrl+[ and Ctrl+] restack.
keyboardHelp.align: Ctrl+Shift with an arrow key aligns, Alt+Shift+H and Alt+Shift+V centre, Alt+H and Alt+V distribute.
keyboardHelp.text: Enter or a double-click writes in a shape or edits text; Escape or Ctrl+Enter ends it. Ctrl+Shift+< and > size text, Alt+W makes it grow or wrap.
keyboardHelp.view: Ctrl+Z undoes, Ctrl+Shift+Z redoes. Ctrl+= and Ctrl+- zoom, Shift+1 fits, Ctrl+' shows the grid, Page Up and Page Down scroll.
keyboardHelp.help: ? lists every shortcut, Ctrl+/ opens the command palette.
